plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that when the film director Steven Spielberg made Close Encounters of the Third Kind, his 1977 movie about people meeting visitors from space, he based its eccentric but brilliant UFO scientist on Jacques Vallée, a real-life UFO researcher. In the film that character is played by François Truffaut. If so, one of the best-known UFO films took its hero from a real investigator.
